description: In repos/identity-vessel/src/services/jwt.ts, the JWT_SECRET fallback is the literal dev-secret-change-in-production. Add a boot-time guard that refuses to start when JWT_SECRET equals that literal, unless ALLOW_INSECURE_API_KEY_SECRET=1, matching the guard that already exists for API_KEY_SECRET in repos/identity-vessel/src/index.ts.
goal_text: In repos/identity-vessel/src/services/jwt.ts, the JWT_SECRET fallback is the literal dev-secret-change-in-production. Add a boot-time guard that refuses to start when JWT_SECRET equals that literal, unless ALLOW_INSECURE_API_KEY_SECRET=1, matching the guard that already exists for API_KEY_SECRET in repos/identity-vessel/src/index.ts.
